text:
maria: Hey team — heads up, LargeBank (enterprise) asking if we can do a 2-week on-prem POC in an air-gapped DC. They want tiny install artifacts (USB delivery), signed delta updates only, and an SLA for patch turnaround. Can ops/eng/security weigh in?

devon: +1. Key asks from BA: max bundle size <2GB for USB stick, offline activation flow, and a way to verify provenance without outbound checks. They also asked about CE/quantized weights vs full float.

kai: We can produce a microbundle approach: split runtime into core (static) + model shards. Core ~800MB, model shards variable. For quantized weights we have q4_0 and q8_0 profiles — q4_0 shards are ~1/4 size of fp16. We can sign each shard with our image-signing key and include a manifest with checksums.

maria: Do we have an example manifest to show them? They want to hand to their security review.

kai: Example manifest (simple):
```json
{
  "manifest_version": "1",
  "components": [
    {"name": "core.tar.gz", "sha256": "<hex>", "signed": true},
    {"name": "weights.q4_0.bin", "sha256": "<hex>", "signed": true}
  ],
  "install_instructions": "offline: unpack core, load weights, run ./start.sh --offline"
}
```

nina: For security: we need to confirm two things before we sign off to Legal: 1) private key storage (we must use HSM/KMS with FIPS-certified module for customer-delivered signing or provide attestation), 2) upgrade policy for air-gapped installs (we need a documented anti-rollback and cryptographic timestamping). Also they asked about telemetry — we must confirm opt-out+no-egress by default.

jord: Operational constraints: our current delta-update tooling supports binary diffs for operator-managed images (rsync/delta patches), but offline clients will need a small patcher binary. Patcher adds ~12MB. We can produce a USB-friendly 'delta bundle' that contains only changed shards + patcher + manifest. Typical delta sizes vary; for quantized weights deltas are usually 20-40% of shard size.

maria: Pricing ask from procurement: if we do an air-gapped POC (2w) + option to extend to 3 months reserved for customer, do we do time-and-materials for POC and a pro-rated commit for reserved? Any guidance on discounting for offline packaging work?

devon: Standard: POC is T&M (SE hours + packaging support). If they convert to a 3-month reserved Dedicated, we can apply a credit for packaging work up to X hours. For air-gap signing/HSM integration there's a one-time professional services fee. I can sketch numbers but need PM to confirm margins.

kai: A couple of engineering caveats: 1) If they insist on on-disk encryption with custom KMS, we will need a short dev cycle for KMS bindings if they want HSM in their environment. 2) Model quantization changes may affect accuracy — we should include an eval check (small eval set) in the POC acceptance criteria.

nina: Security questionnaire likely will ask: regenerateable reproducible builds? supply-chain provenance? We should provide: SBOM (signed), manifest, signing chain, and an offline verification script. Also provide an escalation path for CVEs and a max patch SLA (e.g., 30/90/180 days depending severity). They asked for a 7-day SLA for critical hotfixes in air-gap — we need to confirm feasibility.

jord: On SLA: ops can commit to packaging and signed-delta delivery within 7 business days for CVE-CRITICAL if we have the right entitlements and pre-agreed escalation. For other hotfixes timeline is longer (30 business days). Also need to negotiate logistics for physical delivery (shipments) in contract.

maria: Great. Action items: @devon draft commercial proposal (POC T&M line items + optional 3-month reserved pricing + one-time packaging/signing fee). @kai prepare a small manifest + delta example and quantized size estimates. @nina draft security attachment (SBOM, signing process, telemetry opt-out statement, patch SLA table). @jord propose logistics statement (USB image process + courier SLA).

shipbot: deploy-bot: created ticket SVC-12109 for "Airgap POC packaging & signing" assigned to eng-runtime.

devon: I'll have a draft commercial attached by EOD tomorrow. If we want to appear conservative on timelines, call out 7 business days for critical with a dependency clause (on shipping and customer's ability to test).

kai: I'll attach a sample microbundle and a quick size table. Also adding a small code snippet for offline verification: `shasum -a 256 -c manifest.sha256` and a signed manifest verify step `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify key.pub -signature manifest.sig manifest.json`.

nina: Also add a note: if customer requires us to sign with their in-house HSM, we'll need a one-time secure key exchange and acceptance test in a lab environment. That adds ~5 business days.

maria: Perfect. I'll keep Legal looped and push the RFP attachments. Thanks everyone.

devon: ping @maria — do we want to include an optional demo where we boot the microbundle from USB in their isolated lab? That helps with acceptance criteria.

maria: Yes, include it as optional add-on: onsite 1-day demo + remote support. Add as T&M line in draft. :+1:

shipbot: deploy-bot: ticket SVC-12109 updated: assignee -> kai, label -> airgap-poc

maria: closing loop — I'll post updates to the customer thread and cc this channel. If anyone has a sample from prior deals (manifests, SBOM) please paste here.

devon: I'll upload an anonymized SBOM snippet later.

kai: uploading microbundle example to drive (link shared)

nina: thanks — I'll start the security attachment now and loop Legal."
